Triage: **`needs-user-decision` + `domain:spec`** — this is a public-contract fork (make `title` optional vs. sanction a sentinel), and resolving it in any direction changes the accepted metadata set, so it routes to the spec lane per the acceptance-surface criterion (seat directive ③).

**Premise verified** on `origin/main` @ `a3c0865`: `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:225` — `title: I18nLabelSchema.describe('Page title')`, no `.optional()` (contrast `subtitle:226`, optional). The filer's claim holds: the schema requires what the platform's own default `page:header` deliberately omits.

**Dedup**: repo-scoped search ("PageHeaderProps title required optional") returns only this card; #6776 (added `PageHeaderProps`) is closed; no open PR touches `component.zod.ts:224-232`. objectui#4232 / PR objectui#4290 are the measurement source, not shadows — the fix lands here, not there.

**Four-lens block** (#7498):
1. **Platform long-term coherence**: A/B removes the standing special case where the platform's canonical emitter violates the platform's own schema; C adds a sentinel convention (contract accretion) and contradicts the record-derived renderer heading.
2. **Measured business pull**: zero today — the write path accepts the node (opaque `properties` record, proven by objectui#4290 pins); pull arrives the moment any props-level validation/designer lint runs against header nodes.
3. **AI-agent error-resistance**: a required key the canonical emitter omits teaches agents to distrust the validator; "omitted ⇒ renderer-derived, documented in the docstring" is the spelling hardest to misuse.
4. **Startup scope discipline**: A is a one-line relaxation + docstring, no new key; C creates a permanent sentinel obligation on every seeded page.

Not `target:v17`: four-class test fails — nothing on a shipped path flags today (latent declared≠emitted contradiction; the validator in question runs on no live path yet).

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

**Ruling: A/B merged.** `PageHeaderProps.title` becomes OPTIONAL, and its describe states the sanctioned spelling: title omitted ⇒ the renderer derives the heading from the record (matching the shipped renderer and `buildDefaultPageSchema`'s emission). Option C (synthesizer emits a sentinel) is rejected — it would push a placeholder into every seeded page against the renderer's record-derived heading.
